q.t: How many days are there in a week?
q.e: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday — 7 days.

q.t: How many months are there in a year?
q.e: January to December makes 12 months.

q.t: How many days are there in January?
q.e: January is one of the long months, with 31 days.

q.t: Which month comes just after March?
q.e: The order goes January, February, March, April …

q.t: The poem in this chapter says how many seasons are there in a year?
q.e: Spring, summer, rainy season, autumn and winter — five seasons.

q.t: The short hand of a clock is on 3 and the long hand is on 12. What time is it?
q.e: The short (hour) hand tells the hour; the long hand on 12 means exactly o’clock.

q.t: On a clock, the short hand is the:
q.e: The short hand moves slowly and tells the hour.

q.t: You stand facing the rising sun. Which direction are you facing?
q.e: The sun rises in the East.

q.t: In which season do peacocks dance and frogs hop in lots of rain?
q.e: Peacocks dance and frogs come out when it rains a lot.

q.t: In which season do leaves fall to the ground?
q.e: In autumn many trees drop their old leaves.

q.t: How many days are there in February in most years?
q.e: February is the shortest month: 28 days (29 in a leap year).

q.t: How many days are there in April?
q.e: April, June, September and November have 30 days.

q.t: You face the rising sun. Which direction is behind you?
q.e: You face East, and the opposite of East is West.

q.t: You face the rising sun. Which direction is on your left?
q.e: Facing East, your left hand points North.

q.t: You face the rising sun. Which direction is on your right?
q.e: Facing East, your right hand points South.

q.t: Which of these lasts for months, not hours?
q.e: Summer vacation goes on for weeks and weeks; the others are done in a few hours or less.

q.t: Which of these is done in hours, not months?
o: A seed growing into a tall tree
q.e: A meal is ready in an hour or so; the others take months or longer.

q.t: A train leaves at 8 o’clock in the morning and arrives at 1 o’clock in the afternoon. How many hours is the journey?
q.e: 8 to 12 is 4 hours, and 12 to 1 is 1 more: 4 + 1 = 5.

q.t: Gargi wakes up at 6 o’clock and goes to school at 7 o’clock. How many hours later does she go to school?
q.e: From 6 to 7 the hour hand moves one number: 1 hour.

q.t: What does a calendar tell us?
o: Only the time of a train
q.e: A calendar shows the days, dates and months of the year.

q.t: March has 31 days and April has 30 days. How many days in both months together?
Which months have 30 days?
q.e: Only these four have 30. February has 28 or 29, and the rest have 31.

q.t: 15 August is a Tuesday. What day is 22 August?
q.e: 22 is 7 days after 15, and after 7 days the same weekday comes back.

q.t: Today is Monday. What day will it be 2 days from now?
q.e: Monday → Tuesday (1 day) → Wednesday (2 days).

q.t: A bus drops a family at 9 o’clock in the morning and comes back after 8 hours. When does it come back?
q.e: 9 to 12 is 3 hours; 5 more hours after 12 is 5 o’clock. 3 + 5 = 8 hours.

q.t: The long hand is on 12 and the short hand is on 9. What time is it?
q.e: The short hand shows the hour (9); the long hand on 12 means o’clock.

q.t: At 6 o’clock, where is the short (hour) hand?
q.e: At any o’clock time, the hour hand points at that hour’s number.

q.t: You face North. Which direction is on your right?
q.e: If North is in front, East is on the right (the rising-sun side) and West on the left.

q.t: How many months have 31 days?
q.e: January, March, May, July, August, October, December — 7 months.

q.t: How many weeks make 14 days?
q.e: 1 week is 7 days, and 7 + 7 = 14.

q.t: June has 30 days and July has 31 days. How many days in both together?
Today is the 25th of a month that has 30 days. How many more days until the last day of the month?
q.e: Count on from 25: 26, 27, 28, 29, 30 — 5 days.

q.t: A trip starts on 24 November and ends on 28 November. How many days long is the trip, counting both the first and last day?
q.e: 24, 25, 26, 27, 28 — five days. (28 − 24 = 4, plus the first day.)

q.t: A train leaves at 2 o’clock. The journey takes 3 hours. When does it arrive?
q.e: 2 + 3 = 5, so 5 o’clock.

q.t: It is 11 o’clock. What time will it be 2 hours later?
q.e: 11 → 12 is 1 hour, 12 → 1 is another. A clock starts again at 1 after 12.

q.t: You face North, then turn all the way round to face the opposite way. Which direction do you face now?
q.e: North and South are opposite each other.

q.t: You face West. Which direction is on your left?
q.e: Facing West is the reverse of facing East, so left and right swap: North goes to your right, South to your left.

q.t: 1 March is a Wednesday. What day is 8 March?
q.e: 8 is 7 days after 1, and 7 days later is the same weekday.

q.t: 1 March is a Wednesday. What day is 10 March?
q.e: 8 March is Wednesday again; 9 is Thursday and 10 is Friday.

q.t: A month has 31 days and starts on a Sunday. How many Sundays are in it?
q.e: Sundays fall on 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29 — that is 5. The next would be 36, past 31.
